cues.t: The Dutch cycle tracks are of course great for people cycling. They are safe
enough for small children and they are so safe that children only slightly
older can cycle around unsupervised.
Even going fast as an avid cyclist is also no problem on a well-designed cycle
track. They can be used by young and old. But the cycle tracks are good for
other reasons too. They offer unexpected protection.
This little boy can run around freely, which he could never have directly next
to fastmoving motorized traffic. And this guy must think the cycle tracks
were especially built for him.
But there is a large group of people who really benefit from the cycling
infrastructure in the Netherlands.
People with disabilities use them to go
from A to B, giving them a huge freedom.
Because with special vehicles adapted to their specific needs, they can get out
by themselves in safety. Even in the center of the cities in heavy traffic,
the cycling infra makes it safe for them
too. With some supervision
or a little help, disabled people in the Netherlands enjoy a great freedom to get
out and to a very high age.
Some of the vehicles could also be used on the road, but most of the mobility scooters are
perfectly okay to use on the cycle tracks. The mobility scooters go almost
as fast as people cycling, and the width of the average cycle track in the
Netherlands is enough to overtake them if necessary.

The cycle tracks offer great opportunities to get out into nature and
to have some physical exercise or at least some fresh air even when you are a
little less able.
And of course, you can go with a friend too.
